name: landmine cossack squat
description: A side-to-side deep squat holding a landmine end at your chest. It works the glutes, inner thighs and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet wide, holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee deeply.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Push through the bent leg to return to centre.
Keep your chest tall and heel down on the working side.
